title: Manzikert 1071: The Sultan Who Set a Captive Emperor Free
summary: Tells how, on the twenty-sixth of August, ten seventy-one, at Manzikert, the Seljuk Sultan Alp Arslan defeated the army of the Byzantine Emperor Romanos the Fourth Diogenes and took the emperor captive. The episode covers Andronikos Doukas pulling the rearguard out of the battle, the emperor being released only to be blinded by his own court, and how the civil war that followed opened Anatolia to the Turkish tribes.
